title: Meet Claude Slides, Claude Design and Claude Docs
format_note: One scripted user session (Frankie, Varde 2.0 jacket launch) moves through Slides, Design and Docs inside a single chat, bookended by a type card and a logo.
one_thing: Three products are one conversation: a single prompt becomes a deck, social images and a one-pager, and you steer each by commenting.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. Music only; all meaning is carried by on-screen type and typed UI text.
transcript.script_shape: Tagline, then a user prompt, then three escalating edits (slide, social sizes, doc), a collaboration burst, and the line 'Claude makes it. You steer it.'

structure.frame0: Warm off-white poster. At t=0 the 'Now in beta' pill and 'Create docs,' are already typing in (strips/window-01-0s.jpg); the full three-line headline is complete by 0.46 s.
structure.first_3s: Headline 'Create docs, slides, and designs. Same conversation.' holds from 0.46 s; at 2 s the three product names turn into icon chips inside the sentence (f0002.jpg).

beats.what: Serif tagline 'Create docs, slides, and designs. Same conversation.' with a Now in beta pill; product names become icon chips.
Chips collapse into the Claude home screen with an Output menu listing Docs, Slides, Design, Artifact.
Slides is chosen; a zip file is dragged onto a drop zone over the blurred home screen.
The prompt is typed: 'here's the launch kit for the Varde 2.0. build the reveal deck for fri's readiness review.'
Claude replies 'Your deck is ready'; the deck opens beside the chat with eight slide thumbnails.
Camera pushes into slide 2; headline text is retyped and the background recolored cyan from a design-system palette.
A comment tagged @Claude asks for social images in typical sizes; Claude answers in the thread.
A design canvas appears with the jacket slide rebalanced into 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 boards.
Zoomed edits: the date line recolored from cyan to ember via palette, then 'update the accent color across all versions'.
New request for a one-pager; Claude asks a multiple-choice question and the user picks 'The weight'.
A Docs page writes itself: lead message, a 5-bar weight chart, a line-up table, with Claude, Zak and Jenn cursors and comments.
Collaborator avatars count 7 to 8 comments; a lone Share button pulses with confetti outlines.
'Claude makes it. You steer it.' types in with Claude and You cursor tags.
Spark and Claude wordmark centered on cream; music falls to silence from 91.0 s.

hero_moment.what: Palette click flips the slide from dark to cyan in about 0.3 s (strips/window-20-28.084s.jpg), on the start of music section D at 27.985 s.

ending.cta_text: Claude makes it. You steer it.
ending.what: Typed line with two labelled cursors, then the Claude spark and wordmark; logo is on screen from at least t=90 s to the end.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: One continuous scripted session; something typed, selected or zoomed changes every 1-2 s. 3 shots run over 10 s, the longest 20.58 s (metrics.json). No burst (bursts is empty); the bursts that exist are camera pushes.

look.ground: Warm off-white cream for the Claude frames; the demo content is a near-black teal slide world with cyan and ember accents.
palette: terracotta orange (Claude spark, send button, cursor tag)
look.accent_use: Terracotta marks Claude itself (spark, Claude cursor tag, send button); cyan and ember belong to the demo brand Talvik and swap in the edit.
look.type: Tagline and logo line in a high-contrast serif; UI in a neutral grotesque; demo slides in a heavy grotesque headline with spaced-caps labels.

title_measurements.text: Claude makes it. You steer it. (while typing)

look.depth: Flat. Windows carry soft drop shadows over cream; the chat/canvas panes are stacked layers, with zooms rather than parallax.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Wide window at t=18 s, then repeated pushes into the active control (toolbar f0017, palette f0026, comment box f0029) until it fills the frame; pull back to wide when a new surface appears.
product_ui.notes: Zoomed frames read at 25-30 px glyphs. Wide frames (f0010 t=18, f0023 t=44) show chat text at roughly 7-8 px, so only the headline-sized slide text survives phone width.

motion.text_entry: Headline lines fade up within 0.46 s, staggered about 0.1 s apart (strips/window-01-0s.jpg); later copy is typed character by character with a live cursor.
motion.ui_motion: Menus open, chips collapse, a palette click recolors the slide in about 0.3 s, charts and tables fill as Claude types with a tagged cursor, avatars add a fourth then fifth face.
motion.camera: Constant scale pushes and pans onto the active UI control, with a hard jump from window to full-slide framing at 20.58 s.
motion.eases: Chip collapse out (3.67-3.92 s) is about 0.25 s against 0.46 s for the headline in; UI state changes settle fast and then hold.

transitions.cause: A palette click or typed command changes the slide, doc or chart in place.
Camera pushes onto the control about to be used or the canvas just built.
Window framing jumps to the same slide filling the frame; detector also counts fast pans.
Product names in the tagline become the Output menu items they describe.
Share button in the doc toolbar becomes the same button alone, enlarged, with confetti.

on_screen_lines.text: Create docs, slides, and designs. Same conversation.
here's the launch kit for the Varde 2.0. build the reveal deck for fri's readiness review.
Your deck is ready — eight slides, one job each.
Rain is a given. Shells should come prepared.
@Claude lets use this slide design and mock up the social images, the typical sizes
On it — I'll start a design canvas for these. Four sizes: landscape, square, portrait and story, each rebalanced around the shell.
@Claude update the accent color and image size + placement across all versions
Should the one-pager lead with the taped seams or the weight?
Varde 2.0 — field messaging / Claimed weight, waterproof shells: Varde 2.0 11.2 oz
Claude makes it. You steer it.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: The tagline holds about 3.1 s for 7 words (rule asks 2.6 s). The 22-word Claude reply holds about 3 s, below the rule's 7.1 s: the film shows it as proof of activity, not to be read in full.

sound.sfx: None established. No sfx tag in audio.json and I cannot hear the film, so click or typing sounds are unverified.
sound.vo_music_balance: No voiceover; integrated loudness -15 LUFS, short-term max -11.6, loudness range 5.5 LU.
sound.energy_arc: Section changes at 5.5, 16.3, 28.0, 45.0, 50.3, 66.9, 77.9 and 89.9 s; last 3.6 s silent (91.01-94.63 s) under the held logo.
sound.sync_to_picture: Not locked: cuts_on_strong_onset_share 0.167 against chance_share 0.128 (difference 0.039). The hero recolor at 28.17 s and logo near 90 s fall on section starts 27.985 and 89.905.

good.observation: The tagline is the hook and the thesis: a three-line serif headline fills frame 0 and says all three products in one sentence, then the product names turn into chips that are the next screen's menu.
Every product capability is shown as a task one fictional person does with one fixture (the Varde 2.0 jacket), so the audience tracks a single story across slides, social sizes and a doc.
good.evidence: f0010, f0024, f0040 share headline and figures

good.observation: Camera pushes hold the active control at full frame, so typed prompts and menus read at 25-30 px glyphs instead of the 7-8 px of the wide window.
Collaboration is visible rather than described: tagged Claude, Zak and Jenn cursors type into the same doc and comments appear beside it, then the closing line reuses the same two-cursor idea.
Pacing needs no cut burst. Median shot is 2.54 s, static share is 0.13 and the longest static run is 4 s, so the eye always has a typed character or state change to follow.
The ending is short and plain: a six-word line typed on cream, then the logo, with 3.6 s of silence for the music to settle.

weak.observation: The opening product section (4-20 s) is the longest uninterrupted stretch at 20.58 s; wide frames show chat text at roughly 7-8 px, so it reads as texture rather than copy on a phone.
Loudness is above the social master target: -15 LUFS integrated with true peak +0.1 dBTP, over the -1 dBTP ceiling.
Some UI detail slips past: the 22-word Claude reply holds about 3 s and the doc body text cannot be read at that speed.

rule_candidates.rule: Open on the sentence itself: type the headline from frame 0 so a partial line is already on screen, and complete the full 3-line headline within 0.5 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: strips/window-01-0s.jpg: 'Create docs,' at 0 s, three lines by 0.458 s.

rule_candidates.rule: A sparse single-subject serif title can run 8.9-11.5 % of frame height on three lines when it is the only content and holds about 3 s.
A demo that is one continuous scripted session can hold shots to 20 s if the screen changes at least every 2 s; hard cuts then stay near 11 per minute.
rule_candidates.evidence: longest shot 20.58 s, median 2.54 s, longest static run 4 s.

rule_candidates.rule: A calm UI demo needs no cut burst; its energy peak is a single state change (a recolor in 0.3 s) placed on a music section start.
rule_candidates.evidence: bursts empty; recolor 28.17 s, section D starts 27.985 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Push the camera until the control being used fills the frame, then pull back only when a new surface appears.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0017, f0026, f0029 zoomed; f0010 wide at t=18 with 7-8 px text.

rule_candidates.rule: Carry one headline phrase and one fixture product through every surface shown, so three products read as one story.
rule_candidates.evidence: 'Rain is a given.' on f0011, f0024, f0040.

rule_candidates.rule: Turn the closing line into a typing action with two labelled cursors (maker and user) so the slogan demonstrates the product's collaboration.
End with a plain line held about 3 s, then a logo held 4 s or more, with the music dropping to silence under the logo.
rule_candidates.evidence: line t=85.5-89; logo from t=90; silence 91.01-94.63 s.
